'''2012 European Championship Dez DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Dez]] at [[2012 European Championship]] (European Championship).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' European Championship
